# Hyperdrive release input

This is Ken Stone's original VIC-20 Hyperdrive. The recovered listing credits
Ken Stone and John Hardy and records copyright Micro Parts, 1982. John Hardy's
Hyperdrive II is a separate game.

`HYPERDRV.COM` and the unmodified manifest were downloaded from the
[successful upstream Linux CI artifact](https://github.com/jhlagado/hyperdrive/actions/runs/34150855440/artifacts/10029304378) for revision `624fd56518a80762821c5bfcc3355e9a76d1eb34`.
The executable SHA-256 is `a3db132195631da3cd80885d9072b7b7cf1bb96118fc24363be71b93c7be3870`.

Triptych installs these verified bytes into fresh disks. The
[upstream source](https://github.com/jhlagado/hyperdrive/tree/624fd56518a80762821c5bfcc3355e9a76d1eb34)
and included GPLv3 license accompany this input. The source repository retains
the recovered BASIC and archive files. The native ATOM port includes the story,
help and complete game in the COM, with no companion data file required.

Type `HYPERDRV` at the CP/M prompt. Existing saved disks retain their bytes;
install the game explicitly through Files when it is absent. SAVE and LOAD
operate CP/M disk slots. Export a disk backup to retain a separate copy.
